Kommentar: A quantity of 0.8-5 g sample were weighed in 80 ml centrifuge tubes, and added a suite of internal standards (PCB-29, -112 and -207, 4’-OH-13C-CB159, 4-OH-13C-CB187, BDE-77, -119, -183 and 13C-209), 4 ml 2% NaCl and 10 ml 1 M H2SO4. The samples were extracted twice with cyclohexane and acetone (2:1) using an ultrasonic processor. Lipid contents were determined gravimetrically using the whole extracts. The dry extracts were re-dissolved in 2 mL cyclohexane. This extract was parted in two, of which 1 mL were cleaned up with 4 ml concentrated H2SO4 (purity 96%), and 1 mL were cleaned up on a GPC (Gilson 233 XL on-line column switching system with Gilson 402 syringe pump and Gilson 307 pump) packed with Bio-Beads S-X3 (200-400 Mesh). The extracts that were cleaned with acid were subsequently derivatized with pyridine:acetic anhydride (1:1) before evaporation to a final volume of 100 µL. The extracts that were cleaned on the GPC were evaporated to the final volume of 100 µL directly following the clean up. Determinations of the analytes were done either on a GC-2xµECD system (PCBs and pesticides) or on a GC-MS system (BFRs, OHCBs, OH-BDEs, PCP and TBP)
